Four-stage pipeline

Every model output audited before delivery.

Yankı sits inline between your application and any OpenAI-compatible, vLLM, SGLang or commercial inference endpoint, executing four deterministic stages in under 0.3 milliseconds.

01

Pre-inference guardrail short-circuit

Normalized Turkish and English rule packs intercept high-risk crisis or policy-blocked inputs in 0.04 ms—returning a deterministic response with zero model tokens invoked.

02

Reasoning trace & strict JSON gate

Strips chain-of-thought <think>...</think> blocks and markdown wrappers from reasoning models, enforcing typed field bounds and failing closed on malformed payloads.

03

1-to-1 Unicode & multi-source span audit

Verifies every cited quote against retrieved chunk IDs using index-preserving character folding, returning exact [start_char, end_char) slices or stripping fabricated spans.
